item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD attracts some sellers amid geopolitical uncertainties
item.description: The GBP/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's move higher and edges lower during the Asian session on Tuesday. Spot prices, however, manage to hold above the 1.3400 mark as investors await further developments surrounding the US-Israel-Iran war before placing fresh directional bets.

item.title: Europe: Energy shock tests policy response – Standard Chartered
item.description: Standard Chartered economists argue that Europe faces a renewed energy price shock from the Middle East conflict, with Oil and natural gas prices sharply higher.

item.title: RBA’s Hauser: Response depends on size and persistence of the price shock, that is very uncertain
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said on Tuesday that volatility in oil prices and the Middle East is a genuine challenge for central banks. Hauser further stated that the response depends on the size and persistence of the price shock, which is very uncertain.

item.title: EUR/USD declines to near 1.1600 amid Middle East war
item.description: The EUR/USD pair edges lower to around 1.1615 during the early European session on Tuesday. Concerns over oil flow disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz boost the US Dollar (USD) as a safe-haven and create a headwind for the major pair.

item.title: Oil: Volatility, Hormuz risks and countdown clock – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank strategists Molly Schwartz and Michael Every highlight extreme volatility in Brent, which spiked towards $120 before closing below $90, driven by Saudi supply disruptions, G7 stockpile plans and US policy options.

item.title: CNY: Export strength underpins currency – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur highlights exceptionally strong Chinese export data, with February exports up nearly 40% year-on-year and the combined January–February surplus reaching about 6.2% of GDP.

item.title: Fed: Conflict complicates rate-cut path – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Americas Macro Strategist John Velis argues that the Middle East conflict hits the U.S. economy via higher Oil prices, weaker portfolios and greater uncertainty, creating a negative supply shock.

item.title: Gold holds steady below $5,200 amid Middle East tensions, Fed rate cut outlook
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to modest intraday gains heading into the European session on Tuesday, though it lacks follow-through buying and remains below the $5,200 mark.

item.title: Saudi Aramco CEO: I am concerned about elevated risks that people are facing in region
item.description: The President and CEO of Saudi Aramco, Amin H. Nasser, said on Tuesday that he is concerned about the elevated risks that people are facing in the region. He added that the company are doing its best to meet the majority of our customers' requirements under the current circumstances.

item.title: Brent: Volatile war premium unwinds on Iran headlines – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Senior Currency Analyst Michael Wan highlights extreme volatility in Brent as prices spiked from US$90/bbl to US$120/bbl before retracing, driven by comments from President Trump that the Iran war could be ending soon.
